name: An Interacting-Cycle Wedge Coefficient Space
statement: There is a 49-concept convex-realizable ample class on eight coordinates whose coefficient space has homotopy type $S^2\vee S^2\vee S^2$.
proof: Two four-vertex directed-cycle diagonals meet in the full diagonal. Modulo it they are two distinct lines in $\mathbb R^4$; radial retraction gives $S^3$ minus four points, equivalently a wedge of three two-spheres.
